FROM amazoncorretto:25
ENV APP_NAME menden-backend

EXPOSE 8080

ADD https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/releases/download/v2.20.1/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar .

COPY menden-app/build/libs/menden-app.jar app.jar

ENV SPRING_PROFILE=prod
ENV SERVICE_NAME=menden-backend
ENV NAMESPACE=menden

ENV JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS "-javaagent:/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar -Dotel.resource.attributes=service.name=$SERVICE_NAME -Dotel.resource.attributes.deployment.environment=$SPRING_PROFILE -Dotel.resource.attributes.service.namespace=$NAMESPACE"

ENTRYPOINT exec java -Dspring.profiles.active="$SPRING_PROFILE" -jar /app.jar===
FROM nginx:latest

COPY dist/apps/erlebnis.stadt/browser /usr/share/nginx/html

# The maplibre module worker and the shared chunk it imports. Their asset glob is silent when it
# matches nothing, so without this a renamed maplibre dist file ships a blank map with a green
# pipeline. Named here rather than derived: this layer has no node.
# scripts/verify-maplibre-assets.mjs lists every place the filename is coupled, including this one.
RUN for file in maplibre-gl-worker.mjs maplibre-gl-shared.mjs; do \
        test -f "/usr/share/nginx/html/$file" \
            || { echo "missing $file in the image -- see scripts/verify-maplibre-assets.mjs"; exit 1; }; \
    done

COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
